sourceDescription: ASR/TTS models for the OlliteRT server. These are not chat models - load them into their engine slot (Load ASR / Load TTS) while the server is running.

models.name: Kokoro 82M TTS
models.description: Kokoro-82M text-to-speech (MediaPipe LLM TTS engine). Not a chat model - while the server is running, use the Load TTS button on this card. 54 voices, GPU-capable. OpenAI-compatible: POST /v1/audio/speech, GET /v1/audio/voices.

models.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B ASR
models.description: Open-weight NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 on-device speech recognition (MediaPipe LLM ASR engine). Not a chat model - while the server is running, use the Load ASR button on this card. 25 European languages. OpenAI-compatible: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions.
